findings: Main, Plaster, Smoke and StairsFloor each have two original occlusion permutations with invocation >= active-count guard before pointer load at base + 16*invocation. The actual load is v4uint Aligned16.

CurvedHalfTimber has no PhysicalStorageBuffer pointer type or physical load in either permutation; position/radius fields come from its actual instance_buffer descriptor. Preserve original numeric push payload but do not invent a positions resource dependency.

Owned positions is a separate ShadowedBuffer<InstanceCullData> from boxed instance data. GpuWorld import_to_rg imports only data, and current BDA lookup drops its temporary ManagedBuffer. Current cull pass metadata is empty; this is an actual declaration gap, not a measured crash.

The existing device_address_reads path admits actual Arc/bounds/BDA through the current graph session, imports by physical identity, declares access0x1a/group1 and exact buffer range. It is sufficient; no GraphicsDevice/allocator/planner extension required.

ManagedPassResources retains every declared pass operand regardless of whether a barrier exists; executor drains those owners into the command. Bound range patches attach the same physical SyncCell and submission receipts. Completed commands release owners only after real completion; cancellation retires declaration leases.

Existing producer creates the full positions initial allocation and sparse dirty flush uses the actual BufferHost upload path. Adding a real read allows existing update synchronization to see that use; no additional upload, fake clear or wait-idle is warranted.
implementation_requirements: Attach actual chunks only to Main and Plaster/Smoke/StairsFloor. Zero active-count subsets remain skipped; Curved and external paths keep their original access/push/dispatch behavior.

Derive byte range from the same active count packed into this dispatch: checked count * size_of::<InstanceCullData>() (16), offset0 and exact size. Reject empty/out-of-bounds/stale/mismatched metadata with typed error.

Resolve full id+generation through the exact frame BufferHost before the original infallible device_address call; retain owner.shared() in the chunk. Compare returned address with the address in the unchanged native payload and reject mismatch.
Preserve original main/custom word order, count, dispatch and pass order. Propagate new Result through the sole scene_compute production call; no fallback chunk or successful missing owner path.

Actual builder tests must inspect attached Main/custom metadata, unchanged push/dispatch and Curved exclusion; primitive setter tests alone do not establish caller wiring. Actual BufferHost tests should cover generation/address/range plus cancellation and in-flight owner lifetime. Central runner owns execution.

Final design wording must distinguish source-level mutation/dirty/flush methods from unexecuted actual OS Edit/Reload scheduling; neither an observed crash nor a proven reload release path exists in this review.
performance_scope: One existing Arc chunk per actual active owned subset/stage and short existing slot resolution lock. No new GPU operation or lock-held wait. Vec allocation and real performance remain unmeasured.
